title.narrative: Outcome 4: Provided practical steps for the use of the Abu Dhabi Memorandum on Good Practices for Education and Countering Violent Extremism through bringing together the international community, technical experts and civil society organization/NGOs

description.narrative: As requested by the EU, Hedayah will support the Global Counter Terrorism Forum GCTF Initiative on Education for the Prevention and Countering of Violent Extremism Conducive to Terrorism, which seeks to update existing good practices and provide practical steps for the concrete use of the Abu Dhabi Memorandum and Action Plan. Hedayah will provide substantive and logistical support to the EU with the Initiative Launch Meeting, Thematic Expert Workshop, Research Brief, Toolkit, Trainer of Trainers Curriculum and Final Conference to present the findings. The events are likely to be spread across the following locations; the previous cochair of the GCTF, Morocco, and the central hub for the EU, Brussels, and the new cochair of the GCTF, Egypt. Crucial to the success of the outputs will be uniting the international P/CVE policymakers, technical experts as well as CSO/NGOs in the respective launch and final conference locations.
